comment: Footprint regression budgets in MiB (docs/measurements/footprint.md). Memory is the anonymous resident memory (RssAnon) of each compose container's main process, idle and after the e2e suite run with E2E_RESTART=0 on the same processes; binaries are linux/amd64 with -trimpath -ldflags '-s -w'. They are guard rails with headroom over the measured values, not targets. Unbudgeted services are test fixtures: equity-core is a second equity of the e2e overlay (equity is the budgeted one).
